# Executive customer review — template v1

Output: one structured report rendered as a standalone PDF and editable 16:9 QBR
slides. Use approved Vercel logo/slide master, Geist typography and restrained neutral
colors. Branding assets and recipient policy are confirmed in 009. Do not bake all
text into an image; include accessible reading order and useful chart labels.

Header: customer/workload, month or quarter, as-of date, sponsor and delivery lead,
audience/classification, report and template versions, review status.

| Section / slide | Required content |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Executive decision brief | Customer objective, period outcome, changes and requested executive decisions |
| 2. Maturity journey | Scoped dimension movement, evidence and next milestone; no unsupported overall score |
| 3. Value and adoption | Baseline/current/target, unit/window, method and caveats; distinguish forecast from realized outcome |
| 4. Delivery portfolio | Completed, active and planned engagements; acceptance, milestone forecast and material scope changes |
| 5. Risk and readiness | Material account/delivery risks, owners, mitigations, support/handoff readiness |
| 6. Next-period plan | Priorities, customer decisions, dependencies, qualified expansion opportunities and next reviews |
| Appendix | Evidence, metric definitions, detailed milestones and audience-appropriate economics |

Missing evidence remains visible; do not invent progress or ROI. Maintain consistent
period/currency and comparable chart denominators. Allow optional sections to be
omitted with a reason; preserve the six-section narrative. Validate overflowing text,
chart labels, page breaks, slide layout, links and approved brand use before release.
Published versions carry reviewer/time and source lineage; sends have separate receipts.
